chapter: Leaving Stuff Smith; Benny Carter and Fletcher Henderson
title: Cab Calloway's repeated calls; sending Dizzy Gillespie to the Cotton Club
summary: Cab had asked Jones and Cozy to join since the Stuff days; Jones had sent Dizzy Gillespie down to try out instead, and while with Fletcher he now got Cab's third call.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: So everybody went over with Smack, so now, while we're over with Smack, we're having a ball, you know, because it's nice and the money was short, and now, in the meantime, and this was the third time, Cab -- I get a call from Cab, you know.
Is this the first time you'd ever heard from Cab?
No, it was the third time, because he was calling me and Cozy all the time with Stuff. when he was

He wanted us to come to the Cotton Club, and we was working in the Green Lantern Room at the Edison Hotel with Stuff. The Cotton Club had moved downtown and he had come backstage there and talked about joining the band. You know, he was trying out trumpet players. That's when I sent Diz down. I said, "Look he's trying out trumpet players down there, Diz, why don't you go down there and see about that?" You know, so he went down and he got the job. So I stayed with Stuff, because I wasn't particular about leaving until I really got sick, you know. So then, after we worked with Fletcher, now all the time working with Fletcher, Cab, he says, "I want
you to come with the band," you know. So I said all right. So I had to put in a notice. So he said okay. So then I tell Fletcher.
